messages:
eric_netops: Observing sudden spike to /v1/embeddings from multiple regions starting 11:03 UTC. ~95k rps, tiny payloads.

sam.sre: Oncall here, looking. can you paste top ASNs + headers? will triage.

eric_netops: Top ASNs: 13335, 36351, 45102. Header sample: `X-Client-Version: sdk-1.2.3`, `User-Agent: curl/7.68.0`. Bodies like `{"input":"a"}` repeated.

lina_sec: @sam.sre please ensure full request headers/bodies are preserved. Need raw payloads and headers in sec-logs bucket, encrypted with prod-ingest-kms.

sam.sre: creating incident slice and copying logs. temporary mitigation: apply WAF denylist for abusive ASNs + set per-IP rate limit to 20r/s on /v1/embeddings.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: waf-rule-1718765432 -> edge-waf-cluster. rollout ~12s.

maria_support: seeing ~10 customers with timeouts, drafting status page. do we publish external notice?

eric_netops: yes - status note: degraded embeddings latency for some customers, mitigation active. no data exfil observed.

ops-bot: waf rule waf-rule-1718765432 applied to edge-embeddings-prod-01..04 (success).

sam.sre: mitigation initial numbers: blocked ASN traffic -82%, overall rps down to ~22k. seeing new small-source scatter; adding signature for repeated tiny payloads.

lina_sec: Request: open temporary RBAC read for "incident-responders" group on sec-logs bucket for 4h. Need security lead approval and audit entry.

tom_prod: approved. add 4h window and record change in RBAC audit log.

maria_support: status page updated: "Investigating elevated traffic impacting embedding endpoints; mitigations in progress. No customer data compromise suspected."

sam.sre: next steps: 1) edge-waf team to maintain ASN denylist + auto-update 2) deploy payload-signature rule for tiny repeated bodies 3) enable anomaly alerts on token-pattern/seq-length 4) create postmortem ticket and owner: sam.sre

lina_sec: create JIRA SEC-INC-171876 for follow-ups: RBAC change review, KMS encryption verification, runbook updates, retention policy 90d.

eric_netops: monitoring. postmortem sync scheduled 15:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

maria_support: notified affected customers and owners. will escalate if any pushback.

sam.sre: marking incident contained for now. leave rate limits and denylist for 2h then reassess. postmortem ticket created. closing thread after postmortem assigned.
